listings.description: Discover luxury living in Maplewood with this stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home. Featuring a grand foyer, gourmet kitchen with granite countertops, and a spacious family room with a fireplace. The master suite offers a spa-like bathroom and walk-in closet. Enjoy outdoor entertaining on the expansive deck overlooking a beautifully landscaped yard.

Charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home in the desirable Lakeview neighborhood. This property features an open floor plan with a modern kitchen, hardwood floors, and a cozy fireplace. The backyard is perfect for gatherings, complete with a patio and lush greenery. Just a short walk to the lake and local amenities.

Nestled in Cedar Heights, this delightful 2-bedroom home offers a peaceful retreat. The interior boasts a bright living area, updated kitchen, and a sunroom perfect for relaxation. The large backyard is ideal for gardening enthusiasts. Close to parks and shopping, this home is a must-see.

Experience elegance in Riverbend with this exquisite 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom estate. Featuring a grand entrance, chef's kitchen, and a formal dining room. The master suite includes a private balcony and luxurious en-suite bathroom. The outdoor space offers a pool, hot tub, and outdoor kitchen, perfect for entertaining.

Welcome to Pine Valley, where this beautiful 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home awaits. Enjoy the open-concept living area, modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and a cozy fireplace. The master suite features a walk-in closet and en-suite bathroom. The backyard is perfect for summer barbecues with a spacious patio.

This stunning 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home in Willow Creek offers a perfect blend of comfort and style. The home features a gourmet kitchen, formal living and dining rooms, and a family room with a fireplace. The master suite includes a luxurious bathroom and walk-in closet. Enjoy the beautifully landscaped backyard with a covered patio.

Located in the serene Sunset Hills, this 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers breathtaking views and modern amenities. The open floor plan includes a spacious living area, updated kitchen, and a master suite with a private bath. The outdoor space features a deck and garden, perfect for enjoying the sunset.

Charming 2-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom home in the heart of Oakwood. This property features a cozy living room, updated kitchen, and a sunroom. The backyard is perfect for entertaining with a patio and mature trees. Conveniently located near schools and shopping.

Luxury awaits in Brookside with this magnificent 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home. Featuring a grand entrance, gourmet kitchen, and a spacious family room with a fireplace. The master suite offers a spa-like bathroom and walk-in closet. The outdoor space includes a pool and patio, perfect for entertaining.

Discover this beautiful 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home in Meadow Park. The open floor plan includes a modern kitchen, living room with a fireplace, and a master suite with an en-suite bathroom. The backyard is perfect for gatherings with a deck and garden. Close to parks and schools.
